title: Vertex Operator Algebras with Haagerup Symmetry
exact_target: Construct a conformal vertex algebra realizing Haagerup symmetry data, or establish an obstruction to such a realization.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006358 (OWR-14299511-007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Subfactors and Applications (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/34, pp. 1823--1886. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The report leaves the precise realization framework part of the problem. A no-go result in one restricted VOA class would not settle all permitted realizations.
